newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chevalier Intl raises stake in associate.
newsitem.headline: Chevalier Intl raises stake in associate.

text.p: Chevalier International Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it had raised its stake in Chevalier (OA) International Ltd to about 50.87 percent from about 47.16 percent held on September 30, 1996.

The company said in a statement that it had bought 23.88 million shares at prices ranging from HK$0.69 to HK$0.84 per share in the market between October 1, 1996 and January 9. It then bought 7.39 million shares at HK$0.80 to HK$0.83 per share.
Chevalier International said it had reclassified Chevalier (OA) International, a supplier of office automation and telecommunications systems, as a subsidiary from an associate.
It said it had no present intention of changing the existing board or principal businesses of Chevalier (OA) International.
Chevalier International said it had paid about HK$25.26 million for the acquisitions, financed by working capital.

It said it had not immediately disclosed the acquisitions once its stake had risen above 50 percent because of a misinterpretation of an assets test calculation. It said the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong was reviewing the matter.
